description: The plot illustrates the performance of three different methods - On-policy RL, LUFFY, and SFT - with respect to temperature, comparing their accuracy. The x-axis represents temperature, with a linear scale ranging from 0.1 to 1.0, and tick labels at intervals of 0.1. The y-axis represents accuracy, labeled as 'Accuracy (Pass@8)', with a linear scale ranging from 62.5 to 80.0, and tick labels at intervals of 2.5. The On-policy RL line is depicted in orange with triangle markers and a solid line style, starting at around 62.5 at a temperature of 0.1, dropping to around 62.5 at 0.2, then rising to approximately 72.5 at 0.3, before fluctuating to around 67.5 at 0.5, peaking at about 75.0 at 0.6, dropping to 65.0 at 0.7, and then rising to around 72.5 at 1.0. The LUFFY line is shown in red with star markers and a solid line style, beginning at around 75.0 at 0.1, rising to approximately 77.5 at 0.2, then generally increasing to around 80.0 at 1.0, with some fluctuations. The SFT line is represented in blue with triangle markers and a solid line style, starting at around 75.0 at 0.1, remaining relatively steady until 0.6, where it drops to around 72.5, then declining further to approximately 72.5 at 0.7 before rising to around 74.0 at 1.0.
